description: Use this when someone wants to sell their own second-hand item on Vinted and asks what price to list it at, or how fast it will sell at a price. Gives what the model sells for, a quicker-sale price and what others ask now. Do not use for buying decisions (use check_resale_price) or for writing the listing's text.

condition.description: Its condition in the person's words, e.g. 'like new', 'screen scratched'.
condition.title: Condition

item.description: The item: brand, model, storage or size, e.g. 'iPhone 12 64GB'.
item.title: Item

site.description: The Vinted site the person uses, as its country code: fr, de, it, es, nl, be, pl, pt, at, lt, cz, sk, hu, ro, se, dk, fi, ie, uk, us. Sets the currency. Use the person's country when they don't say; leave empty when unknown.
site.title: Site

name: suggest_listing_price
title: Price an item to sell
